Example Guidelines

Conformance

Every widget on the page needs a visible label and a role that assistive software can read.

Note 1

A widget that only shows an icon still needs a text label.

Note 2

A gadget inside a widget follows the same rule.

The rest of this section lists the levels at which a page can conform to these guidelines.

Glossary

gadget
A part of a widget that a user can operate on its own, such as a button in a toolbar widget.
widget
A control made of one or more gadgets, where each gadget has its own label.
